{{Quote|Jaller's still stuck at HQ. Haven't seen him for two days, but that's normal for Jaller.|Telti Obrim discusses her husband, CSF Captain Jaller Obrim|<ref name="Order66">''[[Order 66: A Republic Commando Novel]]''</ref>}}
The '''Coruscant Security Force Headquarters''', located in [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], served as the main base of operations for the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]]. It contained the offices of the CSF's [[Coruscant Security Force Senior Command|senior command]] as well as the [[Anti-Terrorism Unit]], [[Organized Crime Unit]], and the [[Coruscant Security Force Dispatch|dispatch]] center. Missions were planned and coordinated from the headquarters, and the Anti-Terrorism and Organized Crime units held briefings there on any on-going operations.

==Description==
{{Quote|We're not taking any chances. There's a whole squad escorting him back to headquarters.|Officer Anstiss, after arresting a criminal|<ref name="SWTORCantina" />}}
The [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] Headquarters, located in [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], was the base of [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police]] operations of the Coruscant Security Force and contained the offices of the CSF's [[Coruscant Security Force Senior Command|senior command]]<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero" /> and the [[Coruscant Security Force Dispatch|dispatch]] center.<ref name="Tempest">''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]''</ref> It also housed the offices and briefing rooms of the [[Anti-Terrorism Unit]] and the [[Organized Crime Unit]]. The CSF Headquarters were separate from the CSF's various [[Coruscant Security Force Divisional Headquarters|divisional headquarters]], which were located across Galactic City.<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero" />

==History==
{{Quote|Word from our undercover team and their informants is that someone is offering explosives and arms on the black market. It's amazing how fast this scum flows in to fill the gaps. Time for us to move in. And only one warning before you open fire, okay? Let's see how much we can clean up once and for all.|Organized Crime Unit squad briefing at the CSF Headquarters|<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero" />}}
The CSF Headquarters was built prior to the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="SWTORCantina" /> Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="SWTORdate" /> [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] [[Anstiss]] arrested a criminal named [[Gambo]] who was escorted back to the headquarters to be booked.<ref name="SWTORCantina" /> Around that [[Time/Legends|time]] as well, CSF [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Jaffkee]] reported back to headquarters after planting [[Listening device/Legends|listening devices]] in the [[Justicar territory|sector]] of Coruscant controlled by the [[Justicars' Brigade]], an outlawed [[Militia/Legends|militia]].<ref name="SWTORWhitenoise">{{TORcite|type=general|White Noise|Coruscant}}</ref> In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]], the Organized Crime Unit had meetings in its briefing rooms on illegal weapons shipments. Along with the Anti-Terrorism Unit and several [[Clone commando/Legends|Republic commandos]], the Organized Crime Unit conducted [[Mission to Coruscant (Clone Wars)|raids]] to stop the flow of weapons onto the planet.<ref name="Republic Commando: Triple Zero" /> When on a case, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jaller Obrim]], [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the Anti-Terrorism Unit, sometimes spent [[Standard day/Legends|days]] at the headquarters without going [[Jaller Obrim's residence|home]] to see [[Telti Obrim|his wife]].<ref name="Order66" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Coruscant Security Force Headquarters first appeared in ''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]'', a novel written by [[Karen Traviss]] and published on [[February 28]], [[2006]]. It was mentioned in several other novels before being mentioned again in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] by [[BioWare]], released on [[December 20]], [[2011]].
